transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you that brought you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess for the past year or so, I've just been having some trouble staying on track. 

The smallest thing just... pulls me off what I'm doing before I can stop it. Like if my phone buzzes, or somebody walks past my office. Even just a random thought about my in-laws or something. It just derails me. So... yeah. That's pretty much why I'm here.
Have you noticed any feelings of restlessness, difficulty staying seated, or acting without thinking along with these distractions?

I suppose so. Um... sitting still is just kind of tough for me. Like if I'm at a family dinner, or one of those church volunteer meetings. I don't know, it just feels like I've got this motor running inside me. I usually end up needing to shift around or... just do something with my hands.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was extremely elevated, irritable, or you felt like you didn't need as much sleep?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I sleep okay. My mood is just... normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Looking back, did you have similar difficulties with staying focused or being restless when you were a child, like in school or during other activities?

Yeah... I suppose so. It was kind of the same when I was a kid. Um... teachers were always moving my seat around. Said I talked too much. Or I'd just... get up without asking. I guess I had a habit of blurting things out before they even finished asking a question, too. So... yeah. Pretty much the same.
